P063.title: An efficient model for vehicle-track-soil dynamic interaction based on Green's function, cyclic calculation and multi-time-step solution methods
P063.label: Li等（2024）

complete_examples.text: Through detailed validation, discussion and numerical studies, the feasibility and efficiency of the proposed model combing the hybrid integration method and two optimized dynamic solution strategies are fully demonstrated in the dynamic assessment of VTS dynamic interaction.

In this paper, a hybrid integration method based on the implicit scheme and Green’s function is introduced and combined with the cyclic calculation method and the multi-time-step solution method to optimize the dynamic procedure for high-efficient solution of vehicle-track-soil (VTS) dynamic interaction.
